name: pagination
description: Numeric pagination with prev/next, ellipsis, and aria-current on the active page
designIntent: Pagination lets users navigate through paged content. It shows page numbers with ellipsis for large ranges, prev/next buttons, and marks the current page with aria-current=page.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the new page number

props.name: siblings
props.description: How many page buttons to show around the current page

props.name: showFirst
props.description: Force-show the first-page button; defaults to showBoundaries.

props.name: showLast
props.description: Force-show the last-page button; defaults to showBoundaries.

props.name: icons
props.type: { first?: ReactNode; previous?: ReactNode; next?: ReactNode; last?: ReactNode }
props.description: Replace the default ‹ › « » glyphs with custom markup.

examples.title: Wide page range
examples.description: Show more page buttons around the current page

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Pagination for infinite scroll content
antiPatterns.explanation: Pagination implies discrete pages. Use a 'Load more' button or infinite scroll for continuous content.

antiPatterns.title: Don't hide the current page number
antiPatterns.explanation: Users need to know where they are. Always show the active page with aria-current=page.
